c.description:
Price: $4800 / month

Location: 2172 West 14th Ave, Vancouver (Kitsilano)

Available: October 1st

Bedrooms: 4

Bathrooms: 3

PROPERTY DESCRIPTION:
This is a rare opportunity to rent a spacious and character-filled home in one of Vancouver's most desirable neighborhoods. This substantial 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom house offers comfortable living and a unique charm.

EXTERIOR & AMENITIES:

Private Outdoor Space: Enjoy the private backyard with a raised deck that is partially covered by a modern glass canopy, making it perfect for year-round relaxation and entertaining.

Garage: Storage can be stored here or the shed underneath the patio as well.

LOCATION HIGHLIGHTS:

Unbeatable Location: Located on a quiet, tree-lined street in the heart of Kitsilano.

Close to Arbutus: Minutes away from the shops, cafes, and amenities along Arbutus and Broadway street

Very Close to UBC: An exceptionally convenient location for UBC students, staff, and faculty, with easy transit and cycling access to the campus.

Minutes from Broadway: Just steps from the major transit and commercial corridor of Broadway Street, offering endless dining, shopping, and entertainment options.

Parks and Beaches: Easy access to Kitsilano Beach, Jericho Beach, and the waterfront.

LEASE TERMS:

1 Year minimum.

No smoking.

Pets: No large pets

Proof of employment/income, references, and credit check required.

CONTACT:
Please to schedule a viewing. Please introduce yourself and include a few details about who will be living in the house. Showings by appointment only.

DETAILS:

Furnished: No

Appliances: Range/Oven, Refrigerator, Dishwasher, Laundry

Parking: Garage




​Available October 1st
Detached Garage
